subject: Required: CRM commit validation + SKU normalization for August forecast
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Required: CRM commit validation + SKU normalization for August forecast

Team,

Our August forecast still has ~25 active deals with missing or inconsistent CRM fields that are preventing finance from producing an accurate commit. The main problem areas are:
- Amounts (blank or estimated)
- Product/SKU mapping (free-text notes vs structured SKU field)
- Next steps / clear close plan
- Probability (%) not reflective of current stage

Immediate ask: please update the attached forecast_cleanup_template.xlsx and the corresponding HubSpot deals for your accounts by EOD Wednesday, 2026-08-19. Prioritize: deals >= $50k and any with close dates inside the next 90 days.

Mutual action items (short):
1) Owners: validate deal amount in HubSpot (Amount property) and mark source if it's an estimate.
2) Owners: set Product SKU property to one of the approved SKUs (lookup in sheet tab: SKU-mapping).
3) Owners: update Next Step and Forecast Category (Commit / Best Case / Upside).
4) Rev Ops: we'll reconcile exports and push normalized values into a single master report.

I'll be owning reconciliations for Acme cluster (see deal list export on Drive). If you hit ambiguous SKUs, flag in the SKU column and @marissa — she will adjudicate product mapping.

Attachments: forecast_cleanup_template.xlsx (please use, do not send new formats)

Thanks — this is critical for the Friday finance commit meeting.

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
